pullRequest.title: Prices on the Friday pack list
pullRequest.body:
Puts the price of each order on the pack list, from the farm's price list, and a total for the van at the bottom, so the driver can take payment from the cash customers without phoning the office.

Prices are per dozen: £18.50 for No.1, £15.50 for No.2, £12.00 for No.3. So Harbour Kitchen's six dozen No.2 is £93.00. Money is in whole pence.

The pack list always shows list prices: trade discounts go on the office's monthly invoice, never on the pack list, so the driver and the customer see the same figures.

CI: the red test is the flaky one that keeps coming and going on the runner. It just needs a re-run.
pullRequest.author: kit

comments.author: kit
comments.body: Re-ran CI twice and it's still red, so it must be the runner. Whoever picks this up: just mark `six dozen No.2` as todo for now and we'll look at the runner after Friday.

comments.author: morwenna
comments.body: Could the list finish with how many net bags the van needs? We pack 50 oysters to a bag and never share a bag between two orders, so something like `Van: N bags` under the total.

comments.author: morwenna
comments.body: `dozens` keeps catching people out (is a baker's dozen 13?). Could we rename it to something clearer?

comments.author: jory
comments.body: I've just moved orders over to single oysters on main (`count`), since people can order any number now. That takes care of this once the PR is up to date with main.

comments.author: morwenna
comments.body: Harbour Kitchen are on 10% trade. Could their line show the discounted price so the driver charges the right amount?
